thread:
Maria: quick issue from a customer call — the sample projects grid isn't keyboard-friendly. tabbing lands on each card but the visual focus ring is tiny and not very visible. people missed the primary CTA. :grimacing:
Dylan: thanks, can you repro steps? which page and which screen size?
Maria: Console > Quickstart > Samples tab, desktop and tablet. Using Chrome, tab through the grid. focus outline shows but it's 1px and low contrast against card shadow.
Noor: noticed this in our usability lab too. users expected to arrow between cards like a list. grid navigation would be nicer (arrow keys move left/right/up/down).
Sam: implementation-wise we can add roving tabindex to the grid so arrow keys move focus within cards, and keep Tab to move out of the whole grid. That meets common keyboard patterns for grids.
Kevin: agree. add role="grid" on the container and role="gridcell" on cards; manage aria-selected on focus. Also increase focus outline to 3px and use a high-contrast color token.
Elaine: accessibility note: also ensure each sample thumbnail has meaningful alt text, not just "thumbnail". alt text should be the sample name + short verb like "Chatbot sample project thumbnail".
Dylan: design input: do we want the primary action to be an inline button on hover, or always visible for keyboard users?
Maria: from the call, keyboard users missed hover-only controls. let's make primary CTA ("Import sample") focusable and visible for all states. hover-only is not acceptable.
Noor: copy tweak suggestion: shorten "Import sample project to workspace" to "Import sample" or "Add sample" — saves space on narrow cards.
Sam: agree. use "Add sample" as primary and secondary = "Preview". Preview should open a modal; modal must trap focus and restore to the card on close.
Kevin: modal accessibility checklist: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trap, return focus to invoker, and announce state changes via aria-live for long-running imports.
Elaine: when import completes, announce "Sample added to workspace" with role=status and aria-live=polite. Also ensure success toast does not steal focus.
Dylan: for visuals: update focus ring token, add a 12px focus offset so it doesn't overlap card content, and ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1. Also add a subtle selected state for keyboard users (outline + faint inset).
Maria: also a11y nit: cards currently rely on spacing for hover affordance. add an explicit visible focus rectangle and increase hit target to 44px for the CTA.
Noor: analytics ask: record events when keyboard users navigate grid (event: samples.grid.keynav) and when they import via keyboard (samples.import.via_keyboard). Helps gauge improvements.
Sam: I'll prototype roving tabindex + modal preview and ensure Tab exits grid as expected.
Kevin: I'll implement grid roles and aria-selected toggles, plus the import success announcement. Will also debounce import events to avoid duplicate imports.
Elaine: I'll write small AT test cases: arrow navigation, Tab into/out of grid, preview modal focus trap, and success announcement. We'll run NVDA/VoiceOver checks.
Dylan: I'll update Figma: visible CTA, focus ring spec, and condensed copy. Will post frames by EOD.
onboard-bot: Note  task #7123 created and assigned to Sam.
Maria: thanks team — feels like a medium lift but key for keyboard-first users. small accessibility wins here will pay off. :sparkles:
